skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Specter's newly coordinated outfit after regaining awareness.
More durable than a uniform, able to bear the great pressures of the Abyss.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Though awoken from her madness, her infatuation with combat remains.
So, is there any shred of insanity left to uncover in this outfit, or was it simply a part of her personality all along?

skins.name: Born as One
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Born as One. An engraving leaves a shadow, like two sides of a coin, or the cycle of day and night. When both are aware of their dual nature, Laurentina possesses a soul most complete, like unto the twin moons.
skins.usage: One of Specter the Unchained's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'Step aside. The silence and blood won't bother me one bit, and I need to get the others back to the ball ASAP.'
